title: Settings
subtitle: Configure every aspect of your agent workspace

general.themeSystemHint: System follows your OS-level light/dark preference.
general.soundOnCompleteHint: Play a soft chime when a run finishes.
general.titleAnimationHint: Show animated terminal title in the CLI.
general.showThinkingHint: Display completed reasoning blocks in the chat history.
general.groupToolCallsHint: Collapse consecutive tool calls into a single chip.
general.languageHint: Changes only the interface text. Prompts, skills, and model output are not affected.
general.animationStyleHint: Animation for the TUI working-state chip.
general.thinkingWordHint: Word shown in the TUI status chip. Single short word.

model.heading: Model
model.notFound: No models found for this provider. The catalog might be empty or still loading.

connection.wsUrlHint: URL of the agent WebSocket server. The server runs alongside the CLI.
connection.startingBody: For development, run ./dev.ps1 from the repo root (optionally set WS_HOST/WS_PORT first). Otherwise launch the WebUI with the CLI: wstack --webui.
connection.healthHint: Live ownership, storage, queue, watcher, and latency report for project services.
connection.healthRestartRequired: Restart the backend once to activate connection health reporting.
connection.endpointInvalidRemedy: The IPC socket path exceeds this platform's length limit, so the shared daemon cannot start. Queries fall back to a slower process-local mode. Remedy: set a shorter TMPDIR (e.g. export TMPDIR=/tmp) and restart WrongStack.

provider.apiKeysBody: Pick a provider from the catalog and add an API key, or manage saved providers.
provider.orEnv: Or set {{env}} in the environment instead.
provider.manageKeys: Manage your API keys and provider configurations
provider.noSavedHint: Add a provider to get started

mcp.fieldDescriptionPlaceholder: GitHub MCP server for repository access
mcp.lazyConnectHint: (don't start until first tool call; auto-sleeps when idle)
mcp.heading: MCP Servers
mcp.recommendedBody: One-click add for popular MCP servers. Click Add to pre-fill the configuration, then confirm. Servers requiring credentials will need their env vars set before use.
mcp.noServersHint: Switch to the Recommended tab to add popular servers, or Add Custom for your own.
mcp.addCustomBody: Configure a custom MCP server with stdio, SSE, or HTTP transport.
mcp.addCustomBodyHint: For popular servers, use the Recommended tab instead — everything is pre-configured for you.
mcp.removeConfirmBody: This removes the MCP server from your configuration.

allowlist.title: Clear saved allowlist?
allowlist.body_one: This will remove the pinned model for {{provider}}. The model picker will fall back to the models.dev catalog.
allowlist.body_other: This will remove the {{count}} pinned models for {{provider}}. The model picker will fall back to the models.dev catalog.
allowlist.undoHint: You can undo this for 8 seconds after confirming.

oauth.termsWarning: Sign in with a subscription instead of an API key. Using a subscription outside its official client may violate the provider's Terms — your account could be rate-limited or banned. An API key is the sanctioned path for programmatic use.
oauth.waitingBrowser: Waiting for you to sign in…
oauth.pasteLoopbackBusy: Loopback port busy — paste the redirect URL
oauth.pasteCantReach: Browser can't reach this server? Paste the redirect URL
oauth.enterCode: Enter this code at the verification page:

agent.autonomyModeHint: How independently the agent proceeds between turns.
agent.autoProceedDelayHint: Milliseconds before the agent auto-proceeds in Auto mode. 0 = immediate.
agent.yoloHint: Bypass tool confirmation prompts — the agent runs without asking.
agent.enableRefineHint: Rewrite prompts before sending — clearer instructions, better results.
agent.refineDelayHint: Countdown before the refined prompt auto-sends.
agent.refineLanguageHint: Keep your language or translate to English for the model.
agent.refinerProviderHint: Provider for goal refinement. Select one from your configured providers.
agent.refinerModelHint: Model for goal refinement. Requires a refiner provider first.
agent.refinerProfileHint: Named fallback profile for goal refinement. Overrides provider+model.
agent.refinerProfileDefault: None — use provider+model or session defaults
agent.reasoningModeHint: Control how the model uses extended thinking. Auto = provider default.
agent.reasoningEffortHint: How much compute the model spends thinking. Only sent when the model supports it.
agent.preserveThinkingHint: Keep reasoning blocks across turns for context continuity.
agent.cacheTtlHint: Prompt cache time-to-live. 1h costs more on write but saves on repeat reads (Anthropic).
agent.capsHint: Use wstack models caps to check what the current model supports. Unsupported settings are silently omitted per-request.

execution.heading: Execution
execution.maxIterationsHint: Hard cap on LLM turns per agent.run().
execution.autoProceedMaxIterationsHint: Stop auto-proceed after N iterations. 0 = unlimited.
execution.confirmExitHint: First Ctrl+C aborts work, second confirms exit.
execution.chimeHint: Terminal bell when an agent run finishes.
execution.breakerHint: Gate bash/exec after repeated failures; trips arm the kill/reset countdown.
execution.breakerTimeoutHint: Delay before automatic kill/reset when the breaker trips. 0 = manual recovery.
execution.availabilityHint: Prevent autonomous and overnight runs from using selected providers or models during recurring windows.

features.chimeraDedicatedHint: Automated code quality review that runs after every agent session. Catches regressions, anti-patterns, and potential bugs.
features.chimeraSectionEnabledHint: Run a code review agent after every iteration.
features.chimeraProviderHint: Provider for the review agent. Select one from your configured providers.
features.chimeraModelHint: Model for the review agent. Requires a provider first.
features.chimeraMaxFilesHint: Maximum number of changed files included in a single review call.
features.chimeraAutoFixHint: Whether the review agent should automatically apply fixes for issues it finds.
features.chimeraPickModelHint: Select a provider and model for post-session code review.
features.autoReviewSectionEnabledHint: Run a review agent mid-session on every file change.
features.autoReviewFallbackProfileHint: Named fallback profile for the auto-review agent. Overrides provider+model.
features.autoReviewFallbackProfileNone: None — use provider+model or session defaults
features.autoReviewFallbackModelsHint: Models the auto-review fallback chain resolves from the profile or the global chain.
features.autoReviewModelHint: Model for the auto-review agent. Requires a provider first.
features.autoReviewDebounceHint: Minimum gap between review triggers after a file change.
features.autoReviewCascadeHint: Follow-up agent threshold — spawns security-scanner and bug-hunter above this severity.
features.autoReviewPickModelHint: Select a provider and model, or a named fallback profile, for mid-session auto-review.
features.pluginsPerPluginHint: Enable or disable individual plugins. Changes take effect on next session.

fallbacks.heading: Model Fallbacks
fallbacks.body: When the active model rate-limits (429/529), 5xx-errors, or stalls — after its own retries — the agent rotates to the next model in this chain. Also used as the default for SDD worker subagents.
fallbacks.autoFallbackHint: When the chain above is empty, auto-derive one from your keyed providers.
fallbacks.favoritesOnlyHint: When auto fallback derives a chain, restrict it to your favorite models.
fallbacks.favoritesEmpty: Favorites are shown first and can constrain auto fallback.

fleet.heading: Fleet & Streaming
fleet.fleetChatVerbosityHint: Show live subagent activity in the fleet panel.
fleet.maxConcurrentHint: Maximum number of subagents that can run simultaneously.
fleet.nextPredictionHint: After a turn completes, predict likely next steps.

integrations.heading: Integrations
integrations.hqPublishingHint: Publish this WebUI/client session to WrongStack HQ.
integrations.hqRawContentHint: Send raw content previews to HQ instead of redacted previews.
integrations.telegramSessionEndHint: Send a summary when a session ends.
integrations.telegramDelegateHint: Send a humanized note when a subagent completes.
integrations.telegramLongToolHint: Notify when a tool exceeds {{ms}}ms. Set 0 to disable.
integrations.disabledHint: Enable the feature in the Context tab to use this section.

context.heading: Context & Memory
context.memoryHint: Persist and recall facts across sessions.
context.indexOnStartHint: Build the codebase symbol index at session start.
context.modelsRegistryHint: Use the models.dev catalog for provider discovery.
context.autoCompactHint: Automatically trim the context window when near limits.
context.compactorStrategyHint: How the context is compacted when it grows too large.
context.contextModeHint: Context window policy — balanced is the default.
context.contextModeDeep: Deep — larger context for complex tasks
context.tokenSavingHint: How aggressively to reduce token usage.
context.pluginsPerPluginHint: Enable or disable individual plugins. Changes take effect on next session.

logs.heading: Logs & Debug
logs.auditLevelHint: Detail level for session audit logs.
logs.fsAccessHint: Scope of the file tools. Applies on the next session.
logs.debugStreamHint: Raw SSE hex-dump to the server stderr for provider debugging.

security.heading: Security & Monitoring
security.brainHint: Decision models, council, escalation and risk ceiling — applied live, saved to the global config.
security.shadowHint: The Shadow Agent monitors all fleet agents, tracks their tasks, and detects anomalies.
security.toolsHint: Enable or disable individual tools. Mutating tools are marked in amber.
security.breakerHint: Gate bash/exec after repeated failures; trips arm the kill/reset countdown.

toast.modelSwitchedNextRequest: Model switched: {{from}} → {{to}}. Active for the next LLM request.
toast.modelSwitchedRunActive: Model switched: {{from}} → {{to}}. Active for the next LLM request; the current run continues and is not restarted.
toast.selectProviderModelFirst: Select a provider and model first
toast.modelSwitchTimeout: Model switch timed out. Please try again.
